<div class="chatbot-container">

<div class="chat-header">
<h1>💬 Chat with Isfar</h1>
<h3>Ask me anything about her background, experience, or interests!</h3>
<div class="chatbot-disclaimer">
<small>ℹ️ This chatbot provides quick answers about Isfar's professional background. For detailed conversations or specific inquiries, please <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/isfarbaset/" target="_blank">connect on LinkedIn</a> or reach out directly.</small>
</div>
</div>

<div class="chat-window">
<div class="chat-messages">
<div class="message bot-message">
<div class="message-content">
👋 Hi there! I'm Isfar's AI assistant, here to share information about her professional background and experience. I can answer questions about her career, education, skills, and interests.

**What I can help with:**
• Professional experience and career journey
• Technical skills and technologies she uses
• Educational background and achievements
• Projects and accomplishments
• Hobbies and personal interests
• Geographic background and experiences

Please keep questions appropriate and professional. What would you like to know about Isfar?
</div>
</div>
</div>

<div class="chat-input-container">
<div class="suggested-questions">
<div class="suggestion-chip">Tell me about her background</div>
<div class="suggestion-chip">What's her experience?</div>
<div class="suggestion-chip">What are her skills?</div>
<div class="suggestion-chip">What are her hobbies?</div>
</div>

<div class="chat-input-wrapper">
<input type="text" id="chat-input" placeholder="Type your question here..." />
<button id="send-button">
<svg width="20" height="20" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">
<path d="m22 2-7 20-4-9-9-4z"/>
<path d="m22 2-11 10"/>
</svg>
</button>
</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>

<script>
// Isfar's knowledge base - updated with correct pronouns
const isfarKnowledge = {
  background: {
    keywords: ['background', 'origin', 'from', 'hometown', 'where', 'born', 'grew up'],
    response: "She's originally from Dhaka, the vibrant capital city of Bangladesh! 🇧🇩 Isfar came to the US in 2015 to pursue her bachelor's degree in Computer Science. She lived in West Michigan for several years before moving to Northern Virginia in 2022. It's been quite a journey across different cultures and places!"
  },
  
  education: {
    keywords: ['education', 'study', 'studied', 'degree', 'school', 'university', 'college', 'georgetown', 'grand valley'],
    response: "Isfar has a strong educational foundation in technology and data science! 🎓 She earned her Bachelor of Science in Computer Science from Grand Valley State University (2015-2020) in Grand Rapids, MI. Most recently, she completed her Master of Science in Data Science & Analytics from Georgetown University in 2025. The combination gives her both technical depth and analytical expertise."
  },
  
  experience: {
    keywords: ['experience', 'work', 'job', 'career', 'professional', 'shift digital', 'array of engineers'],
    response: "She's currently a Data Analyst II at Shift Digital in the Data Operations and Analytics team, where she works with enterprise clients to create data-driven solutions. 📊 Before this, she was a Data Analyst I at the same company (2021-2023), and even earlier, she worked as a Computer Engineer at Array of Engineers (2020-2021) focusing on aerospace software verification and web development. She loves solving complex business problems with data!"
  },
  
  skills: {
    keywords: ['skills', 'technologies', 'programming', 'languages', 'tools', 'python', 'sql', 'data'],
    response: "She works with a diverse set of technologies! 💻 Her core skills include Python, SQL, R, and various data visualization tools like Plotly and Tableau. She's experienced with machine learning frameworks, statistical analysis, and database management. She also has a background in web development and software engineering from her computer science studies. She's passionate about turning complex data into actionable insights!"
  },
  
  hobbies: {
    keywords: ['hobbies', 'interests', 'free time', 'fun', 'enjoy', 'like', 'love', 'outside work'],
    response: "When she's not analyzing data, Isfar loves exploring life's simple pleasures! ☕ She's a big fan of charming cafes and trying new cuisines - there's something magical about discovering a great new restaurant or coffee shop. She also enjoys reading, painting (it's her creative outlet!), and watching movies and TV shows. She finds that these activities help her stay creative and inspired in her professional work too."
  },
  
  location: {
    keywords: ['location', 'live', 'based', 'virginia', 'michigan', 'where do you live'],
    response: "She currently lives in Northern Virginia! 🏠 Isfar moved there in 2022 from West Michigan, where she spent several years during and after her undergraduate studies. The DC area has been amazing for her career in data science, and she loves the vibrant tech community there."
  },
  
  projects: {
    keywords: ['projects', 'portfolio', 'work on', 'built', 'created', 'developed'],
    response: "She's worked on some really interesting projects! 🚀 Her work at Shift Digital involves creating data solutions for enterprise clients, which often means building complex analytics pipelines and visualizations. She also enjoys personal projects that combine her love for data with real-world applications. You can check out some of her work in the projects section of this portfolio!"
  },
  
  goals: {
    keywords: ['goals', 'future', 'aspirations', 'want to', 'plan', 'career goals'],
    response: "She's passionate about leveraging data and algorithms to solve complex business problems! 🎯 Her goal is to continue growing as a data scientist while helping organizations make better decisions through data-driven insights. She particularly enjoys communicating complex findings to non-technical stakeholders - making data accessible and actionable for everyone."
  },
  
  culture: {
    keywords: ['culture', 'bangladesh', 'bengali', 'heritage', 'cultural'],
    response: "Her Bangladeshi heritage is a big part of who she is! 🇧🇩 Growing up in Dhaka gave her a rich cultural foundation, and she loves sharing aspects of Bengali culture with friends here in the US. The values of hard work, education, and family that are central to Bengali culture have definitely shaped her approach to life and career."
  }
};

// Fallback responses for unmatched queries
const fallbackResponses = [
  "I don't have specific information about that topic. I'm designed to share details about Isfar's professional background, education, skills, and interests. What would you like to know about her career journey?",
  "That's outside my knowledge base, but I'd be happy to tell you about Isfar's experience as a Data Analyst, her education, or her journey from Bangladesh to the US. What interests you most?",
  "I'm focused on sharing information about Isfar's professional profile. Try asking about her work experience, technical skills, educational background, or personal interests!",
  "I don't have details on that particular topic. I can tell you about her data science career, her work at Shift Digital, her education at Georgetown, or her background from Bangladesh. What would you like to explore?"
];

function findBestMatch(userInput) {
  const input = userInput.toLowerCase();
  let bestMatch = null;
  let maxMatches = 0;
  
  // Check each category for keyword matches
  for (const [category, data] of Object.entries(isfarKnowledge)) {
    const matches = data.keywords.filter(keyword => input.includes(keyword)).length;
    if (matches > maxMatches) {
      maxMatches = matches;
      bestMatch = data.response;
    }
  }
  
  // If no good matches, return a fallback response
  if (maxMatches === 0) {
    return fallbackResponses[Math.floor(Math.random() * fallbackResponses.length)];
  }
  
  return bestMatch;
}

function addMessage(content, isBot = false) {
  const messagesContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
  const messageDiv = document.createElement('div');
  messageDiv.className = `message ${isBot ? 'bot-message' : 'user-message'}`;
  
  const messageContent = document.createElement('div');
  messageContent.className = 'message-content';
  messageContent.textContent = content;
  
  messageDiv.appendChild(messageContent);
  messagesContainer.appendChild(messageDiv);
  
  // Scroll to bottom
  messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
}

function addTypingIndicator() {
  const messagesContainer = document.querySelector('.chat-messages');
  const typingDiv = document.createElement('div');
  typingDiv.className = 'message bot-message typing-indicator';
  typingDiv.innerHTML = '<div class="message-content"><div class="typing-dots"><span></span><span></span><span></span></div></div>';
  messagesContainer.appendChild(typingDiv);
  messagesContainer.scrollTop = messagesContainer.scrollHeight;
  return typingDiv;
}

function removeTypingIndicator(typingDiv) {
  if (typingDiv && typingDiv.parentNode) {
    typingDiv.parentNode.removeChild(typingDiv);
  }
}

// Content filtering and guardrails
function isInappropriateContent(message) {
  const inappropriatePatterns = [
    // Personal/inappropriate questions
    /\b(phone|number|address|personal|private|contact|email|date|dating|relationship|single|married)\b/i,
    // Inappropriate content
    /\b(sexy|hot|beautiful|attractive|looks|appearance|body|photo|picture|image)\b/i,
    // Off-topic requests
    /\b(help.*with|solve.*problem|homework|assignment|work.*for|job.*for|money|salary|pay)\b/i,
    // Spam/nonsense
    /(.)\1{4,}/, // Repeated characters
    /\b(test|testing|hello){3,}\b/i, // Repeated words
  ];
  
  return inappropriatePatterns.some(pattern => pattern.test(message));
}

function getGuardrailResponse() {
  const responses = [
    "I'm here to share information about Isfar's professional background and experience. Please ask questions related to her career, education, skills, or interests.",
    "Let's keep our conversation focused on Isfar's professional journey, technical skills, and career achievements. What would you like to know about her work experience?",
    "I'd be happy to discuss Isfar's background, education, projects, or professional interests. Please feel free to ask appropriate questions about her career.",
    "This chatbot is designed to share information about Isfar's professional profile. For personal inquiries or detailed discussions, please reach out to her directly."
  ];
  
  return responses[Math.floor(Math.random() * responses.length)];
}

function handleUserMessage(message) {
  if (!message.trim()) return;
  
  // Add user message
  addMessage(message, false);
  
  // Check for inappropriate content
  if (isInappropriateContent(message)) {
    // Show typing indicator briefly
    const typingIndicator = addTypingIndicator();
    setTimeout(() => {
      removeTypingIndicator(typingIndicator);
      addMessage(getGuardrailResponse(), true);
    }, 800);
    return;
  }
  
  // Show typing indicator
  const typingIndicator = addTypingIndicator();
  
  // Simulate thinking time and respond
  setTimeout(() => {
    removeTypingIndicator(typingIndicator);
    const response = findBestMatch(message);
    addMessage(response, true);
  }, 1000 + Math.random() * 1000); // Random delay between 1-2 seconds
}

// Event listeners
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const chatInput = document.getElementById('chat-input');
  const sendButton = document.getElementById('send-button');
  const suggestionChips = document.querySelectorAll('.suggestion-chip');
  
  // Send button click
  sendButton.addEventListener('click', function() {
    const message = chatInput.value;
    handleUserMessage(message);
    chatInput.value = '';
  });
  
  // Enter key press
  chatInput.addEventListener('keypress', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Enter') {
      const message = chatInput.value;
      handleUserMessage(message);
      chatInput.value = '';
    }
  });
  
  // Suggestion chips
  suggestionChips.forEach(chip => {
    chip.addEventListener('click', function() {
      const question = this.textContent;
      handleUserMessage(question);
    });
  });
});
</script>

<style>
.chatbot-container {
  max-width: 800px;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 2rem 1rem;
  font-family: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif;
}

.chat-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  padding: 2rem;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);
  color: white;
  border-radius: 20px 20px 0 0;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

.chat-header h1 {
  margin: 0 0 0.5rem 0;
  font-size: 2.2rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}

  margin: 0;
  font-weight: 300;
  opacity: 0.9;
  font-size: 1.1rem;
}

  margin-top: 1rem;
  padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
  background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
  border-radius: 8px;
  border-left: 3px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.3);
}

  display: block;
  line-height: 1.4;
  opacity: 0.9;
}

  color: white;
  text-decoration: underline;
  text-decoration-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}

  text-decoration-color: white;
}

.chat-window {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 0 0 20px 20px;
  box-shadow: 0 4px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid #e5e7eb;
  border-top: none;
}

.chat-messages {
  height: 500px;
  overflow-y: auto;
  padding: 1.5rem;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1rem;
  background: #f9fafb;
}

  display: flex;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
}

  justify-content: flex-end;
}

  justify-content: flex-start;
}

.message-content {
  max-width: 75%;
  padding: 0.875rem 1.25rem;
  border-radius: 18px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-size: 0.95rem;
}

.user-message .message-content {
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);

}

  background: white;
  color: #374151;

}

}

}

.typing-dots span {
  width: 8px;

}

.typing-dots span:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.typing-dots span:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.typing-dots span:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.6s; }

@keyframes typing {
  0%, 60%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(0.8); }

}

  padding: 1.5rem;

}

  display: flex;
  gap: 0.5rem;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

  border-radius: 20px;

  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;

}

.suggestion-chip:hover {
  background: #667eea;

}

  display: flex;

}

  flex: 1;

  border: 2px solid #e5e7eb;

  outline: none;
  transition: border-color 0.2s ease;
  font-family: inherit;
}

  border-color: #667eea;

}

  background: linear-gradient(135deg, #667eea 0%, #764ba2 100%);

  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all 0.2s ease;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.3);
}

#send-button:hover {
  transform: translateY(-1px);
  box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(102, 126, 234, 0.4);
}

#send-button:active {
  transform: translateY(0);
}

/* Custom scrollbar for chat messages */
.chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 6px;
}

.chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-track {

}

.chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: #cbd5e1;

}

.chat-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover {

}

/* Mobile responsiveness */
@media (max-width: 768px) {

    padding: 1rem;
  }
  
  .chat-header {

  }

  }

  }
